name: Player face layers

health.selection: One complete blood decal per stage; H1 has no blood and stages are not cumulative.
health.zero_percent: 0% selects H10 and preserves the selected expression and powers.

order: selected blood decal with mouth exclusions
composition.invisibility_preserves: metal frame; face skin, ordinary eyes and eyebrows are covered by the mask
composition.gaze_reuse: Eye-only glances keep the same canonical head and expression overlay; only pixels inside the eye openings change.
composition.expression_reuse: Three head geometries, with frontal expression reused by eyes_left, front and eyes_right.
composition.mouth_exclusion: Fitted blood rasters already contain expression/head registration and mouth clearance. Use their pose blood_layers directly, without legacy placement or mouth-exclusion operations.
composition.blood_selection: Each expression/head view selects one complete fitted H2–H10 decal. Eyes-left/front/eyes-right share the same frontal blood raster. H1 has no blood layer.
composition.power_selection: Final eye PNGs are full native96 canvases. Draw the selected pose/color asset at(0,0) without legacy placement, clipping or recoloring.

power_semantics.purple: Strength: purple eye cores with purple wisps.
power_semantics.yellow: Invulnerability: golden eye cores in both eyes, with no wisps.
power_semantics.mixed: Strength and invulnerability: golden eye cores in both eyes with purple strength wisps.

placement_schema.clip_to_base: clip to the corresponding base's alpha

notes: Shared full-cell origins; never independently trim layers.
PNG exports contain no labels or preview backgrounds.
Expression and ordinary gaze are distinct transparent layers.
Ten health stages span100% through0%; percentage changes within a band select the same sprite layers.
Final blood and power raster nodes are drawn directly; registration is already baked into their transparent canvases.
Registration status applies to the current build.

node_schema.asset: reference to an exported reusable layer
node_schema.placement: center-anchored translation, scale, rotation, source_clip and clip_to_base
node_schema.exclude_polygons: final native canvas polygons removed from this node only
node_schema.source: embedded source ID for raw raster parts
node_schema.unavailable: true only while art or placement is pending
